metadata.description: Repository knowledge for coding agents: every repository of an account and every file in each, described in plain files an agent reads without a clone.

plugins.name: repomap
plugins.description: Answers questions about a set of repositories without searching them: which one owns a feature, what it is built with, which file to open, what an account holds. Works from an index kept as plain files - committed with a project, private to a machine, or published for a team - and can build, refresh and fetch that index, and say when it has gone out of date.
